usefulness.rationale: The dossier rests entirely on a single 2026 letter, so the reader learns only her current role, honours, and one courteous acknowledgment. Nothing covers her neuroscience career, FMRIB co-founding, or background, and the dossier never states these gaps, implicitly presenting a one-source snapshot as the person. A meeting prep reader would know her title but almost nothing about her work or priorities. No overclaims found: each statement is directly supported by its cited quote, and the three listed unjustified conclusions (New England Biolabs, Lancet authorship, sole founder) do not appear in the dossier.
